why: Each step adds one new thing to the circle. Step 1 adds a dot at the lower right. Step 2 adds a bar across the right stick. Step 3 adds a second dot at the upper right. So the pattern is dot, bar, dot, bar, and the next step must add a bar. Option 5 keeps both dots and the old bar, and adds a new bar across the upper-right stick. Option 1 is the same as the last figure, and options 3 and 4 move or add dots at the upper left, so they break the pattern.
trick: Track one change at a time. Count the dots and the bars separately in each figure, then see which one is due to grow next.
note: Drawn from a small scan; the alternating dot/bar addition fits only option 5, but the bar position on the upper-right stick is hard to see.
